alias_note: Informal spellings that UCUM does not define are unsupported; use the UCUM spelling.
note: Every unit resolved to a factor over the UCUM base units, a dimension vector in the order given by 'dimensions', and for affine units an offset such that base_value = factor * value + offset. Units flagged arbitrary are not commensurable with anything else, per UCUM section 24, so they convert only to themselves. Units UCUM defines through logarithmic or other non-affine functions are listed in 'unresolved' and must never be converted silently.

[AU].property: procedure defined amount of an allergen using some reference standard

[Amb'a'1'U].property: procedure defined amount of the major allergen of ragweed

[BAU].property: amount of an allergen calibrated through in-vivo testing based on the ID50EAL method of (intradermal dilution for 50mm sum of erythema diameters

[CCID_50].property: biologic activity (infectivity) of an infectious agent preparation

[D'ag'U].property: procedure defined amount of a poliomyelitis d-antigen substance

[EID_50].property: biologic activity (infectivity) of an infectious agent preparation

[FEU].property: amount of fibrinogen broken down into the measured d-dimers

[IR].property: amount of an allergen calibrated through in-vivo testing using the Stallergenes® method

[Lf].property: procedure defined amount of an antigen substance

[PNU].property: procedure defined amount of a protein substance

[TCID_50].property: biologic activity (infectivity) of an infectious agent preparation

[anti'Xa'U].property: biologic activity of factor Xa inhibitor (heparin)

[beth'U].property: biologic activity of factor VIII inhibitor
